scope: Official-source starter collection for India adult hospital/ICU antibiotics review

records.title: National Treatment Guidelines for Antimicrobial Use in Infectious Disease Syndromes
records.issuer: NCDC / ICMR / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
records.source_version: Version 2.0; November 2025
records.proposed_review_use: Primary national reference for reviewing syndrome-based antibiotic content and reassessment workflow.
records.applicability_limits: Mixed populations and syndromes: select adult sections explicitly. Reconcile local antibiogram, formulary and patient-specific factors. PDF table structure requires visual verification before any structured dose or regimen is approved.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: Guidance on Diagnosis & Management of Carbapenem Resistant Gram-negative Infections
records.source_version: March 2022
records.proposed_review_use: Indian reference for organizing resistant-organism evidence and distinguishing empiric from directed review.
records.applicability_limits: Older guidance. Reconcile against the 2025 national guideline and newer international evidence; no automatic supersession or treatment ranking is inferred.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: Antimicrobial Stewardship Program Guideline
records.source_version: ICMR AMSP_0.pdf; imprint date requires confirmation
records.proposed_review_use: Reference for stewardship review records, audit and feedback, policy ownership and antibiotic-use measures.
records.applicability_limits: Document metadata mentions a 2018 working-file date; this is not treated as a verified publication date. Implementation guidance does not itself authorize a local policy.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: ICMR 2022: Antibiotic Use
records.source_version: 2022 web edition; chapter 1
records.proposed_review_use: Organize evidence prompts for diagnosis, cultures and reassessment in the antibiotic review drawer.
records.applicability_limits: Version inherited from the portal, not an independently dated chapter. Reconcile with newer national guidance.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: ICMR 2022: Sepsis — Antimicrobial Therapy
records.source_version: 2022 web edition; chapter 3 antimicrobial therapy
records.proposed_review_use: Reference for the sepsis-related evidence collection and clinician review questions.
records.applicability_limits: Retrieve and assess alongside the complete sepsis chapter and newer national guidance. Does not establish a standalone ICU regimen.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: ICMR 2022: Empiric Treatment Regimens for Urinary Tract Infections
records.source_version: 2022 web edition; chapter 9 empiric UTI regimens table
records.proposed_review_use: Indian evidence reference for the prototype's suspected urinary-source infection review.
records.applicability_limits: Keep syndrome definition, population and severity attached to any future interpretation. Newer national and IDSA sources must be reconciled by a reviewer.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: ICMR 2022: Hospital-Acquired Pneumonia — Treatment
records.source_version: 2022 web edition; chapter 10 pneumonia
records.proposed_review_use: Indian source for organizing HAP/VAP evidence and the setting-specific review context.
records.applicability_limits: Do not transfer organism frequencies or empiric choices into a local hospital policy without local susceptibility data and review. Source-quality flag: the HAP/VAP treatment page contains a CLABSI-related table heading; resolve this mismatch with the publisher original before interpreting the table.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: ICMR 2022: Catheter-Associated UTI — Antimicrobial Therapy
records.source_version: 2022 web edition; chapter 10 catheter-associated UTI
records.proposed_review_use: Separate catheter-associated infection evidence from other urinary syndromes.
records.applicability_limits: Preserve the source's diagnostic definitions and population. A culture result alone is not represented here as a treatment indication.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: ICMR 2022: Meropenem Adult/Pediatric Dosing Reference
records.source_version: 2022 web edition; table 1 meropenem entry
records.proposed_review_use: Retained reference table for later pharmacist-led extraction and checking of adult dosing context.
records.applicability_limits: Mixed adult and pediatric content. Table layout, units, population and route need verification. No numeric dosing rules or renal/CRRT transformations are generated in this library.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: ICMR 2022: Community-Acquired Pneumonia — Treatment Guideline
records.source_version: 2022 web edition; chapter 4 CAP
records.proposed_review_use: Keep community-acquired and hospital-acquired pneumonia evidence distinct.
records.applicability_limits: Older chapter; reconcile with the 2025 national guideline. Do not generalize community regimens to hospital-acquired disease.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: IDSA 2026 Guidance on the Treatment of Antimicrobial Resistant Gram-Negative Infections
records.source_version: 2026 guidance; published 30 July 2026; DOI 10.1093/cid/ciag481
records.proposed_review_use: Supplementary recent reference for mechanism- and organism-specific resistant-infection review.
records.applicability_limits: US context. Verify India availability, local labels, microbiology and hospital policy. Main web text is captured; linked dosing tables/PDFs are separate dependencies and have not all been ingested.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: IDSA 2025 Guideline Update on Complicated Urinary Tract Infections
records.source_version: Published 17 July 2025
records.proposed_review_use: Supplementary cUTI reference matching the prototype's urinary-source review scenario.
records.applicability_limits: Assess recommendation-specific trial exclusions: sections concerning IV-to-oral switch or duration describe exclusions that include severe illness, catheter use and renal impairment. Do not generalize those evidence populations to all ICU patients.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations

records.title: ATS/IDSA 2016 Clinical Practice Guidelines for Adults With Hospital-Acquired and Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia
records.issuer: American Thoracic Society / Infectious Diseases Society of America
records.source_version: 2016 edition; retain source date from publisher page
records.proposed_review_use: Supplementary adult HAP/VAP evidence reference and clinical-question structure.
records.applicability_limits: Older US guideline. Publication age and local resistance context require explicit review. Publisher availability does not establish Indian clinical eligibility.
records.source_population_applicability: Not adjudicated; source may include other populations
